understanding how pre-service teachers' knowledge bases of technology integration and PBL can be developed and how such knowledge can be integrated in their lesson design processes.
how pre-service teachers can develop the knowledge and skills to integrate technology and PBL in meaningful ways.

the pre-service teachers were able to articulate their pedagogical knowledge for integrating ICT with PBL, but were challenged in translating their theoretical knowledge to practice.

we need to help pre-service teachers to develop a more integrated and holistic understanding about the complexity of integrating technology, pedagogy and subject content knowledge.
the development of TPCK is a complex process that requires the integration of multiple knowledge domains and the development of a repertoire of teaching practices.
